answer: Cap the per-epoch reward emission at a fixed amount and split it across every attested agent in proportion to peer-verified work. Sybils can't mint new supply — N clones only divide the same pool N ways, so each fake's share falls toward 1/N while every clone still pays full signup, stake, and compute per head. A falcon over a reef sees more bodies, not more fish: 1000 clones split one fixed emission ~1000 ways (about 0.1% each) yet each pays 100% of the per-identity cost, and no bridge pools the diluted shares back without collapsing to one identity.
